name: Apple Inventory Bot
short_desc: Telegram alerts for Apple refurbished stock.
author: gxiang314
description: Monitors Apple's refurbished store and sends Telegram alerts when watched products appear, with price history judgement so you know whether a listing is actually a good deal. Watch rules can be changed by messaging the bot.

form_fields.label: Telegram Owner ID
form_fields.hint: User ID allowed to send commands to the bot

form_fields.label: Telegram Webhook URL
form_fields.hint: Leave empty unless you have a public HTTPS address. Empty means the bot fetches commands over its own outbound connection, which needs no domain, no open port and no certificate — the right setup for a home server. Set it only if you do have such an address, e.g. https://<your-domain>/webhook/telegram.

form_fields.label: List URL
form_fields.hint: Apple refurbished listing page to watch. Defaults to the Taiwan refurbished Mac page.

form_fields.label: Cron Expression
form_fields.hint: Scrape schedule. Defaults to every minute.
